v3.noOpen: No open tasks across your projects.
v3.tasksEmpty: No tasks yet. Add what needs to happen and by when.
v3.msEmpty: No milestones yet. Add the dates that matter, like the IC meeting.
v3.delProjectBody: “{0}” and all of its checklist, tasks, milestones, notes and delegated-work history will be permanently deleted. Linked files on your computer are not touched. This cannot be undone.
v3.howBody: Open an item to add what you have. Mark it Complete after you have checked it. Only complete items count toward readiness.
v3.allTouched: Every item has something. Review them and mark what you have verified as Complete.
v3.hint_document: Link the file where it lives on this computer. Valuator saves the path only and does not read the content.
v3.hint_text: Write a short summary in your own words.
v3.hint_money: Enter the amount with its currency.
v3.hint_structured: List the details, one per line.
v3.welcomeSub: Track requirements, files and dates for each investment. Everything stays on this computer.
v3.startOwnSub: Set up a deal with the VC Investment Review checklist. Takes about a minute.
v3.startSampleSub: Look around with four example projects. Nothing you do there is saved.
v3.noAccount: No account and no internet needed.
v3.w1Sub: Name the deal. You can change this later.
v3.w2Sub: The checklist is what you need to collect before deciding.
v3.w3Sub: Most reviews start with the pitch deck. Link it now or skip.
v3.w3BlankSub: Name the first thing you need from the company.
v3.fileNote: Only file references are stored. Content is not read yet.
v3.gs3: Give a task a due date
v3.toastCreated: Project created. Open any checklist item to begin.
v3.toastDated: Needs attention and Calendar are now in the sidebar. They show what's due.
v3.toastTask: Task added. It's under Tasks & dates.
v3.toastDocs: Documents is now in the sidebar. It lists every linked file.
stages.title: Project stages
stages.note: Each template has its own ordered stages. A project can move to any stage in any order.
stages.name: Stage name
stages.inUseWhy: A stage that projects use can't be deleted. Move those projects to another stage first.
stages.lastOne: A template needs at least one stage.
stages.saveFailed: The stages could not be saved.
